notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Delina.
description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one nonlegendary token copy of Azor with haste that is tapped and attacking.
The Azor token(s) enters the battlefield, preventing opponents from casting instants or sorceries during their next turn.
Repeat each turn.
